file_stem: RWB E1 047 Feature flags for module release with a removal date
title: Feature flags for module release with a removal date
goal: Features ship off and turn on per environment without a deployment; overdue flags are reported
why: Every Epic 1 feature sits behind a flag such as rwb.p1.case-list. Off means the old code path; each flag has an owner and a removal date.
ace_note: No ACE read. Flags are Workbench configuration; Section B features stay behind their flags until RWB-ACE-001.

writes.note: key, owner, value per environment, removal date
who changed what, when and why

stores: ACE audit log; e-mail to owners and the RW-PLATADM group; 30 s flag cache
rules: BR1: off means the previous code path
BR2: every flag has a key, owner, value per environment and removal date
BR4: overdue flags are reported every week
BR5: an unknown key or unreadable store means off
example: Flag rwb.casewf.case-list-queue-column: default off, owner 'P3 squad', removal 2027-01-31
UAT has no value set -> isOn returns false
-> the queue column on SCR-02 stays hidden
